5 Days Amboseli Lake Naivasha Maasai Mara Safari

Package overview

Experience Kenya’s finest wildlife destinations in just 5 unforgettable days. From the elephant-rich plains of , and finally the big cat territory of the , this safari blends adventure, scenic beauty, and exceptional wildlife encounters—including opportunities to spot the

  • Amboseli National Park
  • Kilimanjaro Views: Capture the iconic photo of the snow-capped mountain rising above the dusty plains, especially at sunrise.
  • Large Elephant Herds: Amboseli is famous for some of the largest elephant herds in Africa, offering incredible opportunities for up-close viewing.
  • Swamp Visits: Watch elephants, hippos, and buffalo congregating around the park's permanent marshlands.
  • Lake Naivasha
  • Boat Safari: Cruise the freshwater lake for close encounters with hippos that bob on the surface and vast colonies of majestic birds, including African Fish Eagles.
  • Crescent Island Walking Safari: Enjoy a guided walk among grazing animals (giraffes, zebras, and various antelopes) in a safe, open environment—a unique highlight where you are on foot with the wildlife.
  • Great Rift Valley Views: The drive to Naivasha provides spectacular, sweeping views as you descend into the valley floor.

Day-by-day itinerary

01Day 1 | Nairobi - Amboseli National Park

Pick-up from Nairobi by your Magical Africa Safaris driver-guide. Drive to Amboseli National Park , arriving for lunch. Afternoon game drive exploring the park’s plains with spectacular views of Mount Kilimanjaro . Expect sightings of elephants, lions, cheetahs, zebras, giraffes, and rich birdlife. Dinner & Overnight: Amboseli Safari Lodge / Similar

02Day 2 | Amboseli - Lake Naivasha

Early morning game drive as animals are most active during sunrise. Return for breakfast, then depart Amboseli for the Great Rift Valley . Arrive at Lake Naivasha , a freshwater lake known for birdlife and hippos. Optional activities (extra cost): Boat ride to see hippos Crescent Island walking safari Dinner & Overnight: Lake Naivasha Resort / Similar

03Day 3 | Lake Naivasha → Masai Mara National Reserve

After breakfast, depart for the world-famous Masai Mara National Reserve . Check in at your camp and enjoy lunch. Afternoon game drive across the Mara’s rolling plains teeming with wildlife including lions, elephants, buffaloes, cheetahs, giraffes, and more. Dinner & Overnight: Masai Mara Safari Camp / Similar

04Day 4 | Full Day Masai Mara

Enjoy a full day of game viewing in the Masai Mara. Explore the prime wildlife areas including the Mara River—home to hippos and crocodiles. Great chances of encountering the Big Five , big cats, and various plains game. Optional visit to a Maasai Village (extra cost). Dinner & Overnight: Masai Mara Safari Camp / Similar

05Day 5 | Masai Mara - Nairobi

Early morning game drive for final wildlife sightings. Return to camp for breakfast, then begin your drive back to Nairobi. Drop-off at your Nairobi hotel or the airport. Please note that this safari is fully customizable to suit your travel preferences. You may choose to begin and end the tour in Nairobi, or start in Nairobi and finish in Mombasa if you plan to enjoy a beach extension along the Kenyan Coast. Our experienced Tour Consultants at Magical Africa Safaris are always ready to guide you and help tailor your trip for the best possible wildlife holiday experience.

What's included

  • Game drives in custom 4x4 vehicles with expert guides

What's excluded

  • Soft drinks, alcoholic beverages, and snacks
  • Personal purchases or souvenirs
  • Optional activities (e.g., guided nature walks, cultural visits)
  • Tips and gratuities for driver/guide
  • Items of personal nature (e.g., jackets, binoculars, cameras)
  • Accommodation before or after the safari
  • Travel insurance or international medical cover

From-prices are planning figures for two adults sharing, in a private vehicle with a guide, at the season shown. Your written quote is the only price that applies. International flights, visas, tips, drinks and gorilla permits are separate unless the quote lists them.
